notes: Fib extensions now stay on the chart, and the higher-timeframe modes draw in the right place.
changelog: The 1.000, 1.272 and 1.618 Fib levels now stay on the chart as targets. Before, they were removed as soon as they were drawn.
A Fib level is removed when price closes back through it, and the whole set goes when its pivot breaks, together with the S/R line.
On the higher-timeframe pivot settings, boxes, S/R lines and Fib levels now start at the right bar, matching the higher-timeframe pivot.
Your own setting changes are kept after a reload. A preset only applies when you choose Apply Preset Now.
